title: One status instead of many booleans

slides.say: Two booleans can describe a state that should be impossible.
Forget to update both together, and you can end up with is sending and is sent both true. That should never happen.
Replace them with one status variable that has three valid values. You can still declare constants for readability. They are not state, so they cannot drift apart.

slides.text: One variable can only hold one value: no impossible states.
slides.say: Takeaway: one status variable holds one value at a time, so impossible combinations disappear.
